title: Why throwing AI tools at a problem fails #Shorts
description: Most businesses fail at AI because they throw a tool at the problem before they understand how their own processes even work. Fix the process first. Mo on this, from Building in the Age of AI. #Shorts #AI #founders #operations #startups
